import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def mergeSort_precond (v : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  True
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def merge2 (xs ys : List Int) : List Int :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], ys => ys
  | x :: xs, [] => x :: xs
  | x :: xs, y :: ys =>
      if x ≤ y then x :: merge2 xs (y :: ys) else y :: merge2 (x :: xs) ys
termination_by xs.length + ys.length
decreasing_by
  all_goals simp only [List.length_cons]
  all_goals omega

def msort (l : List Int) : List Int :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | [x] => [x]
  | x :: y :: rest =>
      merge2 (msort ((x :: y :: rest).take ((rest.length + 2) / 2)))
             (msort ((x :: y :: rest).drop ((rest.length + 2) / 2)))
termination_by l.length
decreasing_by
  all_goals simp only [List.length_take, List.length_drop, List.length_cons]
  all_goals omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def mergeSort (v : List Int) (h_precond : mergeSort_precond v) : List Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  msort v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def mergeSort_postcond (v : List Int) (result : List Int) (h_precond : mergeSort_precond v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
   List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) result ∧ result.Perm v
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem merge2_perm : ∀ (xs ys : List Int), (merge2 xs ys).Perm (xs ++ ys) := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro ys
    simp only [merge2, List.nil_append]
    exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil =>
      simp only [merge2, List.append_nil]
      exact List.Perm.refl _
    | cons y ys ih2 =>
      simp only [merge2]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact (ih (y :: ys)).cons x
      · exact (ih2.cons y).trans List.perm_middle.symm

theorem merge2_sorted : ∀ (xs ys : List Int), xs.Sorted (· ≤ ·) → ys.Sorted (· ≤ ·) →
    (merge2 xs ys).Sorted (· ≤ ·) := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro ys _ hy
    simpa only [merge2] using hy
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil =>
      intro hx _
      simpa only [merge2] using hx
    | cons y ys ih2 =>
      intro hx hy
      simp only [merge2]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [List.sorted_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, ih (y :: ys) (List.Sorted.of_cons hx) hy⟩
        intro b hb
        have hb' : b ∈ xs ++ (y :: ys) := (merge2_perm xs (y :: ys)).subset hb
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hb' with hb1 | hb2
        · exact List.rel_of_sorted_cons hx b hb1
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb2 with rfl | hb3
          · exact h
          · exact le_trans h (List.rel_of_sorted_cons hy b hb3)
      · rw [List.sorted_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, ih2 hx (List.Sorted.of_cons hy)⟩
        intro b hb
        have hyx : y ≤ x := (not_le.mp h).le
        have hb' : b ∈ (x :: xs) ++ ys := (merge2_perm (x :: xs) ys).subset hb
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hb' with hb1 | hb2
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb1 with rfl | hb3
          · exact hyx
          · exact le_trans hyx (List.rel_of_sorted_cons hx b hb3)
        · exact List.rel_of_sorted_cons hy b hb2

theorem msort_perm : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Int), l.length ≤ n → (msort l).Perm l := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l hl
    rcases l with _ | ⟨x, t⟩
    · simp only [msort]
      exact List.Perm.refl _
    · simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    rcases l with _ | ⟨x, l'⟩
    · simp only [msort]
      exact List.Perm.refl _
    · rcases l' with _ | ⟨y, rest⟩
      · simp only [msort]
        exact List.Perm.refl _
      · have hlen : rest.length + 2 ≤ n + 1 := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
          omega
        have h1 : ((x :: y :: rest).take ((rest.length + 2) / 2)).length ≤ n := by
          simp only [List.length_take, List.length_cons]
          omega
        have h2 : ((x :: y :: rest).drop ((rest.length + 2) / 2)).length ≤ n := by
          simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_cons]
          omega
        have p1 := ih _ h1
        have p2 := ih _ h2
        have hsplit := List.take_append_drop ((rest.length + 2) / 2) (x :: y :: rest)
        simp only [msort]
        have hres :=
          (merge2_perm (msort ((x :: y :: rest).take ((rest.length + 2) / 2)))
              (msort ((x :: y :: rest).drop ((rest.length + 2) / 2)))).trans (p1.append p2)
        rw [hsplit] at hres
        exact hres

theorem msort_sorted : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Int), l.length ≤ n → (msort l).Sorted (· ≤ ·) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro l hl
    rcases l with _ | ⟨x, t⟩
    · simp only [msort]
      exact List.sorted_nil
    · simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l hl
    rcases l with _ | ⟨x, l'⟩
    · simp only [msort]
      exact List.sorted_nil
    · rcases l' with _ | ⟨y, rest⟩
      · simp only [msort]
        exact List.sorted_singleton x
      · have hlen : rest.length + 2 ≤ n + 1 := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hl
          omega
        have h1 : ((x :: y :: rest).take ((rest.length + 2) / 2)).length ≤ n := by
          simp only [List.length_take, List.length_cons]
          omega
        have h2 : ((x :: y :: rest).drop ((rest.length + 2) / 2)).length ≤ n := by
          simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_cons]
          omega
        simp only [msort]
        exact merge2_sorted _ _ (ih _ h1) (ih _ h2)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem mergeSort_postcond_satisfied (v : List Int) (h_precond : mergeSort_precond v) :
    mergeSort_postcond v (mergeSort v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold mergeSort_postcond mergeSort
  exact ⟨msort_sorted v.length v le_rfl, msort_perm v.length v le_rfl⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
